# Asia Open Briefing: Supply Tightening, Prices Accelerating  
**Bottom line:** Market risk is high (67) and prices are climbing fast (86.7); lock in pricing on neutral‑risk parts now and push hard on elevated‑risk items.

## What changed
- Overall supply risk slipped 0.1 point to 67.0, price trend fell 0.1 to 86.7, confidence steady at 79.8 % [market]​.  
- Fab utilization eased to 74.4 % (below 10‑yr avg 80 %) nudging supply a touch looser [3]​.  
- Producer price index surged +32.6 % annualized, reinforcing tighter, higher pricing pressure [1]​.  
- Global chip sales jumped +148.3 % YoY to $172.6 B, adding demand‑side lift to both supply strain and price rise [2]​.

## Featured part: IPB017N10N5ATMA1
- Lead time **14 weeks**, stock **27,071** units, no on‑order quantity disclosed.  
- Price **$5.56** at qty 1, **$2.51** at 1 k units.  
- Origin **Austria**, tariff **0 %** (no surcharge).

- Processors & advanced logic – **Rising** (66.4, 0.0), **Rising** price 83.8, High confidence.

## Your BOM watchlist
- **10M08SAE144C8G** – lead time 52 wks vs 12 wks norm, price +129 % vs target.

## Outlook
- **Chip prices, next 3 mo:** 77 % chance of rise, expected +7.05 % (‑4.66 % – +18.76 % 80 % range), model‑tested edge.  
- **Chip prices, next 6 mo:** 76 % chance of rise, expected +14.1 % (‑1.13 % – +29.33 % 80 % range), trend‑following baseline.
